name: Balanced Tree Check
description: Checks if a binary tree is height-balanced: for every node, the height difference between left and right subtrees is at most 1.
aim: Determine if a binary tree is balanced by checking that |height(left) - height(right)| ≤ 1 at every node, using a single-pass O(n) approach.
howItWorks: For each node, compute heights of left and right subtrees
If height difference > 1: mark as unbalanced
If any subtree is already unbalanced: propagate -1 (early exit)
Return -1 if unbalanced, actual height otherwise

time.averageCase: Each node visited once with early termination

realWorld: Database index validation — ensure BST stays balanced
AVL/Red-Black tree operations need balance checks
whenToUse: Before deciding to rebalance a BST
Before operations that assume balanced trees
alternatives: Level-order BFS — O(n) iterative balance check
